- Pacers at Heat (8 PM): FanDuel likes Under 237.5 on Pacers injuries; Dimers projects 235 vs 236.5 - too thin. Lean.
- Bulls +14.5 at Celtics: Dimers 57.7%, but big NBA dogs are off-limits after Bulls/Kings lost by 35/27. Pass.
